CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is good singing posture? (1 mark)
   A. Bending over
   B. Slouching
   C. Hiding behind others
   D. Standing tall with shoulders relaxed

2. What is the job of the ropes on a drum? (1 mark)
   A. To make the shell heavy
   B. To decorate the beater
   C. To make the drum float
   D. To hold the skin tight

3. You begin a glide by (1 mark)
   A. jumping from a height
   B. pushing gently off the wall
   C. swimming hard
   D. kicking the wall in anger

4. A display portfolio holds (1 mark)
   A. your best finished works
   B. only rough drafts
   C. only rubbish
   D. tools

5. In a chest pass your thumbs turn downwards (1 mark)
   A. when you sit
   B. never
   C. before you catch
   D. as you release the ball

6. Prone means (1 mark)
   A. standing
   B. sitting
   C. face up
   D. face down

7. The elephant walk stretches the (1 mark)
   A. back and the back of the legs
   B. nose
   C. tongue
   D. ears

8. Learning about animals in games links to (1 mark)
   A. Weather forecasts
   B. Space travel
   C. Swimming lessons only
   D. Agriculture

9. If you are in trouble in the water, you should (1 mark)
   A. stay quiet
   B. hide underwater
   C. swim into the deep end
   D. raise your arm and shout for help

10. Which is a focus when analysing a team sport performance? (1 mark)
   A. The weather only
   B. Teamwork and safety
   C. The price of the ball
   D. The colour of shoes only

11. Unison singing is suitable for an anthem because (1 mark)
   A. everyone can join in the same tune
   B. it is silent
   C. it needs instruments
   D. it uses no notes

12. How many notes are in the melody d r m m r d? (1 mark)
   A. Six
   B. Three
   C. Four
   D. Five

13. In the frog jump, you begin (1 mark)
   A. lying flat
   B. sitting
   C. in a squat with your hands on the ground
   D. standing on one leg

14. A subject in photography is (1 mark)
   A. the screen
   B. the person or thing you photograph
   C. the camera
   D. the battery

15. When you see a crotchet rest, you should (1 mark)
   A. keep the beat but not clap
   B. shout
   C. stop the whole song
   D. clap twice

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Give three ways of caring for a digital camera. (3 marks)

17. Why do we improvise a netball? (3 marks)

18. Why should we take turns and respect others' views when talking about paintings and montages? (3 marks)

19. Name two types of songs learnt in this topic other than folk songs. (2 marks)

20. State four things to think about when analysing an art work. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Standing tall with shoulders relaxed
   Good posture helps breathing.

2. D — To hold the skin tight
   Ropes or lacing keep the skin stretched tight.

3. B — pushing gently off the wall
   A gentle push is enough.

4. A — your best finished works
   It is for showing to others.

5. D — as you release the ball
   Thumbs turn down as the arms straighten and the ball leaves the hands.

6. D — face down
   Prone is face down.

7. A — back and the back of the legs
   Bending forward stretches those muscles.

8. D — Agriculture
   Agriculture teaches about animals.

9. D — raise your arm and shout for help
   Signal for help.

10. B — Teamwork and safety
   Teamwork and safety matter.

11. A — everyone can join in the same tune
   A single tune that everybody sings is simple and strong.

12. A — Six
   Count d, r, m, m, r, d to get six.

13. C — in a squat with your hands on the ground
   You squat and spring forward.

14. B — the person or thing you photograph
   The subject is what you are photographing.

15. A — keep the beat but not clap
   A rest is a silent beat, and the beat continues.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Hold with two hands; use a strap; clean the lens with a soft dry cloth; keep away from water and dust; charge the battery. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Some schools do not have enough balls. We can use materials we have, such as string and waste cloth. It lets more learners practise.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is fair, it shows respect and it helps everyone learn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Sacred songs, patriotic songs and topical songs. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (4 marks)
   Answer: Aesthetic, skills, message and behaviour. Feedback is also accepted.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
